items.text: Notes to the Financial Statements 46. SHARE BASED BENEFITS Certain employees are entitled to participate in the share based payment plans of Siemens AG. Siemens AG grants stock awards as a form of share-based payment to the employees. These awards are subject to a restriction period of three to four years. Stock awards forfeit if the employment with the Company terminates prior to the expiration of the restriction period and can not be transferred, sold, pledged or otherwise encumbered. The allocation of stock awards as a share-based payment has been increasingly tied to corporate performance criteria. The target achievement for the performance criteria ranges between 0% and 200%.
